figurative_meaning_en: To eliminate excess or unnecessary parts as required
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার লেখায় কাটা ছাঁটা করে সারাংশ তৈরি করো।
বাজেটে কাটা ছাঁটা করে খরচ কমানো দরকার।
example_sentences_in_english: Trim his writing to create a summary by cutting out the excess.
We need to cut expenses in the budget by trimming the unnecessary parts.
note: This idiom draws from agricultural or tailoring practices of trimming excess.
